name: Xianyun
description: Xianyun, known by her adeptus title Cloud Retainer, is one of the Adepti of Liyue and mentor to Ganyu and Shenhe. A chatty, knowledgeable crane deity, she fights as an Anemo catalyst user who empowers plunging attacks and provides healing.
